title: FA Cup quarter-final draw: Manchester City host Liverpool, Chelsea to play Port Vale
content:
Manchester City will host Liverpool in the FA Cup quarter-final stage while Chelsea play Port Vale and Arsenal travel to Southampton.

Pep Guardiola’s side, who won the competition in 2023 and were beaten finalists in 2024, will take on 2022 winners Liverpool in the standout tie of the round.

Meanwhile, the winners of West Ham United’s fifth-round tie against Brentford on Monday night will play Leeds United, who are at this stage of the competition for the first time since 2003.

Arsenal, who most recently won the competition in 2020, face a trip to second-tier Southampton while Chelsea, defeated finalists in 2022, will face Port Vale at Stamford Bridge.

Port Vale, who are at bottom of the third-tier League One table, are the lowest-ranked team remaining in the competition, following their shock victory over Sunderland.

Championship side Southampton are the only other non top-flight side remaining, having defeated Fulham in the fifth round.

The quarter-final ties will be played over the weekend of April 4-5.
